changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
create or alter function [dbo].[GetAssetBreadcrumbs] ( @assetUid uniqueidentifier ) returns table as return ( with h as ( select A.ID, A.[ObjectID], A.Object, A.AssetTypeID, I.SubjectAssetID as [ParentID], 0 as [Level] from dbo.Asset A left join dbo.PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 3 where A.Uid = @assetUid
union all
select P.ID, P.[ObjectID] as ID, P.Object, P.AssetTypeID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentID, h.[Level]-1 as [Level] from dbo.Asset P inner join h on P.ID = h.ParentID outer apply ( select SubjectAssetID from dbo.PredicateIntersect i where i.ObjectAssetID = P.ID and PredicateType = 3 ) I ) select distinct top 1000000 [Level], ltrim(rtrim(T.Name)) as TypeName, ltrim(rtrim(D.DisplayValue)) as Name, UT.Url as TypeUrl, U.Url as Url from h inner join dbo.AssetType T on T.ID = h.AssetTypeID left join dbo.AssetDisplayValue D on D.AssetID = h.ID cross apply dbo.GetAssetUrlByID(h.ID) U cross apply dbo.GetAssetTypeUrlById(T.ID) UT where ltrim(rtrim(T.Name)) is not null and ltrim(rtrim(D.DisplayValue)) is not null order by [Level] )
changeSet.rollback:

union all
select P.ID, P.[ObjectID] as ID, P.Object, P.AssetTypeID, I.SubjectID as ParentID, h.[Level]-1 as [Level] from dbo.Asset P inner join h on P.[Object] = h.Object and P.ObjectID = h.ParentID outer apply ( select SubjectID from dbo.PredicateIntersect where Object = P.Object and ObjectID = P.ObjectID and PredicateType = 3 ) I ) select distinct top 1000000 [Level], ltrim(rtrim(T.Name)) as TypeName, ltrim(rtrim(D.DisplayValue)) as Name, UT.Url as TypeUrl, U.Url as Url from h inner join dbo.AssetType T on T.ID = h.AssetTypeID left join dbo.AssetDisplayValue D on D.AssetID = h.ID cross apply dbo.GetAssetUrlByID(h.ID) U cross apply dbo.GetAssetTypeUrlById(T.ID) UT where ltrim(rtrim(T.Name)) is not null and ltrim(rtrim(D.DisplayValue)) is not null order by [Level] )
